{"action":"proof","message":"  have hfac : 80325 = 3^2 * 5^2 * 7 * 17 := by norm_num
  have hdiv : 17 ∣ n ! := by
    have hmul : 17 ∣ 3^2 * 5^2 * 7 * 17 := ⟨3^2 * 5^2 * 7, by ring⟩
    rw [← hfac] at hmul
    exact dvd_trans hmul h₁
  by_contra h
  have hn : n ≤ 16 := by omega
  have hlt : n ! < 17 := by
    calc
      n ! ≤ 16 ! := Nat.factorial_le hn
      _ < 17 := by norm_num
  have : 17 ≤ n ! := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv
  omega"}
